messages:
kai: Flagging a support case: fncall schema rejects are showing up under our generic /chat.generate route in the console and quotas. Customer sees unexpected quota hits.

priya: example req id?

kai: req id d4a9c7, 2026-05-22T10:14:03Z. Validator returned "invalid_function_output" (expected object, got string). Console shows tokens billed to /chat.generate.

lee: quick root cause idea: the route resolution moved to after validation in the streaming pipeline, so validation emits before route metadata is attached. Default route currently set to /chat.generate so early errors get misattributed.

priya: options: 1) move route-resolve back earlier (risk for streaming), 2) populate x-route-hint at ingress so validator can read it, 3) post-process billing events to remap by error kind (accounting risk).

kai: i vote for #2 + small shim. Populate x-route-hint at auth/ingress from the route table, update validator to prefer header when tagging validation errors. Also add a short-term shim: if error_kind==invalid_function_output and no route_hint, set billing.route=/fncall before emitting billing event. Gate both behind a feature-flag.

ops-bot: dry-run query between 2026-05-21T00:00 and 2026-05-22T12:00 UTC for predicate "validation.error_kind:invalid_function_output AND billing.route:'/chat.generate'" => 78 matches. CSV prepared at ops:/tmp/fncall_mislabels_78.csv (dry-run).

billing: we need the per-customer breakdown to reconcile chargeback for dedicated customers. Ops, please coordinate.

priya: i'll open a PR that: injects x-route-hint at ingress, updates validator to read header and emit route_hint in validation payload, and implements the shim behind ff "preserve-route-before-validate". Include unit + e2e that simulates fncall output mismatch and asserts billing.route==/fncall when header present and when shim enabled.

lee: include migration script stub for ops to remap historical events where safe. Also add a temporary dashboard alert to notify on mislabel rate > 3/hr in the canary cohort.

kai: timeline: PR today, 5% canary tomorrow across hosted + dedicated, monitor 6h, expand if stable. After canary we'll run backfill dry-run and coordinate with billing for any adjustments.

ops-bot: acknowledged. Note: server-side changes must be feature-flagged and canaried per release policy.

priya: will add logs and example payloads to the PR and a short KB entry for support explaining reconciliation steps.

lee: thanks. once PR is up i'll loop in billing and support and watch the canary window.
